how_its_made:
We are BeetFarm. BeetFarm is a social platform for record producers where they can have full control of their content. Producers will be able to monetize in our native token through a viewing tier system, and also by selling their content as NFTs.



We will be building our platform using Lens protocol. Users will be greeted with a landing page and prompted to mint their profile. After successfully minting their profile, they will then be encouraged to follow other content creators (producers). These dynamic NFTs are empowering the creator to truly monetize from their content without a middle man. Ceramic will be used to replace our database with a truly decentralized alternative. Using Lit protocol will give us the power to create access control to these dynamic NFTs. All while incorporating Graph as our data is stored and processed on an open network with verifiable integrity which makes querying this data fast, reliable, and secure.



Ultimately, we want producers to have a place where they can cultivate a following with their dynamic NFTs. Usually, artists are the ones who get most of the recognition and pay for the song created, but BeetFarm will open the door for producers to make a living beyond record sales through the ever evolving Web3 space.



Thank you,



BeetFarm
